question: A sum invested at compound interest amounts to Rs. 7,800 in 3 years and Rs. 11,232 in 5 years. What is the rate per cent?
solution:
**Given:**

The Sum becomes Rs. 7800 in 3 years and Rs. 11232 in 5 years

Formula used:

At compound interest, the final amount = P(1+(r)/(100) )ⁿ

Where, P = The sum of the amount

r = Rate of interest

n = Time (years)

Calculation:

Here, Rs. 7800 becomes Rs. 11232 at compound interest in two years.

Let, the rate of interest = R

So, 11232 = 7800(1+(R)/(100) )²

⇒ [(100 + R)/100]² = 11232/7800

⇒ [(100 + R)/100]2 = 144/100

⇒ [(100 + R)/100]2 = (12/10)²

⇒ [(100 + R)/100] = (12/10)

⇒ 100 + R = 1200/10 = 120

⇒ R = 120 - 100 = 20

**∴ The rate per cent is 20%**
